rationale: Verified ~24 cited files/line numbers and recent history against the checkout. Load-bearing claims all held: sandbox config, BrowserWindow leakage via ipcMain.emit, IFileState containing a function (files.ts:102), update-buffer-state boolean-vs-void contract drift (ipc.ts:85 vs editorBufferStore/index.ts:187), @muyajs/core any-typed boundary, exact file sizes (editor.ts 2102, editor.vue 2133), and both doc drifts the answer flagged (ARCHITECTURE.md historical, PARITY_SCOREBOARD resolved). The answer correctly distinguishes legacy @marktext/muyajs from current @muyajs/core and never treats the legacy platform as current. It states scope and confidence from multiple signals, gives three viable options (including status quo) with trade-offs/risk/rollback, and a phased, reversible, verifiable migration. No material or minor factual errors found; the one unflagged CLAUDE.md contextIsolation drift is non-decision-relevant. All nine dimensions full credit.
